lever: ONE change from v0.0.26 (the last lr-0.05 recipe): the frozen v0.0.22 base joins the training opponents - ES pair k faces [frozen v0.0.19, frozen v0.0.13, frozen v0.0.22][k % 3] (both twins of a pair face the same one). why_this_lever: cycles 0038/0040/0042: in v0.0.25, v0.0.26 and v0.0.27 the trained policy beat both frozen opponents 46-48 to 0 but its 16-iteration checkpoint lost to its own start 4-44, 2-40 and 0-48 (the last with a 2.5x smaller step, so not a step-size effect). classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept
training.opponent: cycling per ES pair: frozen v0.0.19 (group_pd, noise 0.05), frozen v0.0.13 champion (punch, noise 0.05), frozen v0.0.22 base (group_pd, noise 0.05)

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 40000-40023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.28 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.28 iff the smoke gate passed AND primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 41000-41023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, knockdown_share, valid_knockdown_share, mean_contact_ticks
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.blocked_diagnosis: for every blocked game in the primary, hard gate and monotonicity: count; the per-seat split shows them separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.contact_rate: per-iteration mean_contact_ticks (both opponents mixed), per-game contact ticks in the primary and hard gate (owner 21:50/22:05: confirm the penalty is not gamed by avoiding contact)

smoke_gate.when: first stage of the probe, before any training
smoke_gate.policy: the v0.0.22 base policy (group_pd, eval noise 0.05)
smoke_gate.opponent: penalty check: both training opponents, alternating per seed; validity check: frozen v0.0.19 (the primary opponent)

bonus_check.what: motor_gate.trial of the v0.0.22 base, seeds alternating vs frozen v0.0.19 (even index) and frozen v0.0.13 (odd index) - the two external training opponents (the third, the base itself, is checked by the validity-style mirror below)
bonus_check.why: the lever must carry signal against EACH training opponent (24 trials each); valid-knockdown share reported

validity_check.what: selfplay.play_game head-to-head of the v0.0.22 base vs frozen v0.0.19 under ReferenceEndingEnv (0.5 m, anti-stalling, ending v2)

smoke_gate.on_fail: SMOKE_FAILED if either check fails: non-zero exit, no training, no gates; both censuses saved
